title: UI/UX Designer Intern (Stage – UI/UX Designer, Fashion)
note: Posting is in French; intern joins the Fashion division's digital design team in Paris and needs fluent French and English.

facts.summary: Internship on the digital operations design team of Chanel's Fashion division in Paris, starting January 2027.
facts.duties: Make mobile, app and desktop mockups, build prototypes, map user flows, add components to the design system and support delivery with project managers.
facts.requirements: Student in a UX/UI program; Figma and Adobe tools (InDesign, Photoshop, After Effects, Illustrator); fluent French and English; interest in fashion, art and photography is a plus.
facts.apply: Apply online through Chanel's careers site; phone screen, then manager and HR interviews.
